args.title: Remember last selected export format in ExportButton
args.body:
File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

Change the export format menu to save the last chosen format in local storage and initialize the component state from it, so the user's selection is remembered across sessions.

label: feature
file: src/components/ExportButton.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The file src/components/ExportButton.tsx is involved because the export format menu there defaults to "csv" and does not remember the user's last selected export format. Changing this file to save and restore the last chosen format from local storage will improve user experience by remembering their selection.
